name: Books
tagline: Reads EPUB books, keeping your place

offers.label: Watch folder
offers.description: Watches the folder `path` for books: each EPUB it holds, and each that arrives, becomes a

offers.label: Scan folder
offers.description: Reads the folder `path`'s EPUBs, giving a book to each file the library does not hold yet.

offers.label: Foldered
offers.description: Reads every watched folder again: what the platform runs when one of them changes.

offers.label: Set text size
offers.description: Sets the page's text size, within what a page can be read at.

offers.label: Set face
offers.description: Sets the face the page is set in.

offers.label: Add font
offers.description: Adds the family `family`, which this device has, to the reader's faces.

offers.label: Set justified
offers.description: Whether the page's paragraphs are justified.

offers.label: Set shelf sort
offers.description: Orders the shelf by title, by author, or by the books added last.

offers.label: Set hide finished
offers.description: Leaves the books a person finished off the shelf, or shows them again.

offers.label: Cycle scheme
offers.description: Steps to the next palette the reader ships with: its bar's quick switch.

offers.label: Set scheme
offers.description: The palette the page is set in, by name.

offers.label: Add scheme
offers.description: A palette of the person's own, from a paper and an ink colour.

offers.label: Find books
offers.description: Searches Project Gutenberg for books matching `query`, taking the answers an earlier search

offers.label: Clear found
offers.description: Takes an online search's answers away.
